items.stem: In Azure Machine Learning, what is the workspace?

options.text: The top-level resource that groups jobs, data assets, models, components and endpoints
options.rationale: Correct: the workspace organises all ML artifacts and configuration.
A model is one artifact within a workspace.
The workspace is a working resource, not merely billing.
Networking is a setting of a workspace, not the workspace itself.

items.explanation: Correct: the workspace organises all ML artifacts and configuration.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are true about deploying models to endpoints in Azure ML? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A managed online endpoint serves real-time scoring requests
options.rationale: Correct: online endpoints provide real-time inference.

options.text: An endpoint can have multiple deployments with traffic split between them
options.rationale: Correct: endpoints can route traffic across deployments for safe rollout.

options.text: You must redeploy the whole workspace to update one model
options.rationale: You update the deployment, not the whole workspace.

options.text: Batch endpoints are for interactive, low-latency single requests
options.rationale: Batch endpoints process large inputs, not low-latency single requests.

items.explanation: Correct: online endpoints provide real-time inference.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Why register a model in the workspace before deployment?

options.text: To version it and track the asset used by an endpoint
options.rationale: Correct: registration gives a versioned, tracked model asset.

options.text: Because unregistered models cannot be trained
options.rationale: Registration follows training; it is not a training prerequisite.

options.text: To delete the training data automatically
Because it converts the model to a VM
options.rationale: Registration does not convert a model into a VM.

items.explanation: Correct: registration gives a versioned, tracked model asset.
